152824922.title: File:Just 10 munits Chicken Ricotta Meatballs with Risoni in Tomato Basil Sauce.jpg

ObjectName.value: Just 10 munits Chicken Ricotta Meatballs with Risoni in Tomato Basil Sauce

Categories.value: Orzo|Chicken dishes of Japan|Vegetable-based food of Japan|Beef dishes of Japan|Stir fried dishes of Japan|Self-published work|Colorful food|Pasta dishes of Japan|Ricotta-based food|Stir fried beef with vegetables|Mushroom dishes in Japan

ImageDescription.value:
Looking for a hearty and delicious meal? These Chicken Ricotta Meatballs with Risoni are perfect for a cozy dinner. Packed with rich flavors from parmesan, lemon, and basil, this dish is both satisfying and easy to make. Follow the steps below to create a meal that will impress your family or guests.

Ingredients:

500g Coles RSPCA Approved Chicken Mince 250g fresh ricotta, crumbled 25g (1/3 cup) finely grated parmesan Finely grated rind of 1 lemon 1 green shallot, finely chopped 1 garlic clove, crushed 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil 500g jar Coles Mum’s Sauce Tomato & Basil 250ml (1 cup) Massel salt-reduced chicken-style liquid stock 1/2 bunch fresh basil, top leaves torn off 105g (1/2 cup) dried risoni pasta Extra parmesan, for serving Instructions:

Step 1: Prepare the Meatballs In a large bowl, combine the chicken mince, ricotta, parmesan, lemon rind, shallot, and garlic. Season the mixture well with salt and pepper. Roll the mixture into about 12 golf ball-sized meatballs and place them on a plate, ready for cooking.

Step 2: Cook the Meatballs and Simmer the Sauce Heat extra virgin olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over high heat. Add the meatballs and cook for 3 minutes, turning them occasionally until they are just browned on all sides. Pour in the Coles Mum’s Sauce Tomato & Basil, chicken stock, and risoni pasta. Stir well to combine the ingredients. Reduce the heat to medium, cover the pan, and let the mixture simmer for 9 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the risoni is tender and the chicken meatballs are cooked through.

Step 3: Serve Top with the torn basil leaves and extra parmesan. Serve immediately for a warm and comforting meal.

Enjoy your Chicken Ricotta Meatballs with Risoni!

This recipe is packed with flavorful ingredients like ricotta, parmesan, and basil, making it a great option for weeknight dinners or special occasions. The chicken mince meatballs, paired with the rich tomato basil sauce and tender risoni, create a delicious, well-balanced dish that everyone will love.
